hypotheses.F1_lexical_edit_directions_recur: Same-token-pair Layer-8 state deltas have median cosine at least 0.20 on both corpora.
hypotheses.F2_semantic_families_abstract_across_wor: Different lexical pairs in the same family have state-delta cosine at least 0.05 above different-family controls on both corpora.
hypotheses.F3_semantic_families_recurrently_reconfi: Same-family different-pair input-projector changes have cosine at least 0.05 above different-family controls on both corpora.
hypotheses.F4_semantic_families_recurrently_reconfi: Same-family different-pair Fisher-projector changes have cosine at least 0.05 above different-family controls on both corpora.
hypotheses.F5_semantic_deltas_hit_top_local_axes: At least 5% of the semantic state-delta energy lies in the four leading local input-sensitivity axes on both corpora.
hypotheses.F6_final_layer8_mlp_state_mediates_seman: Patching only the final-position Layer-8 MLP input reaches median Fisher fidelity at least 0.25 and at least 10% of full counterfactual KL on both corpora.
hypotheses.F7_minimal_edits_change_behavior: The median full counterfactual next-token KL is at least 1e-4 on both corpora.
hypotheses.F8_local_input_operator_is_edit_stable: Base and counterfactual rank-4 input-sensitivity subspaces overlap by at least 0.90 on both corpora.
hypotheses.F9_local_behavioral_operator_is_edit_sta: Base and counterfactual rank-4 Fisher-output subspaces overlap by at least 0.75 on both corpora.
